[![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-009688?style=for-the-badge&logo=fastapi&logoColor=white)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) [![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-20232A?style=for-the-badge&logo=react&logoColor=61DAFB)](https://react.dev/) [![Celery](https://img.shields.io/badge/Celery-37814A?style=for-the-badge&logo=celery&logoColor=white)](https://docs.celeryq.dev/) [![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-316192?style=for-the-badge&logo=postgresql&logoColor=white)](https://www.postgresql.org/) [![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-2496ED?style=for-the-badge&logo=docker&logoColor=white)](https://www.docker.com/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Proprietary-red?style=for-the-badge)](#licença) [Quick Start](#-quick-start) · [Árvore do Conhecimento](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/index.html?tree=sentinelai) · [Arquitetura](#-arquitetura) · [Discovery](#-discovery-engine) · [API](#-api) · [Roadmap](#-roadmap)
--- ## O que é **SentinelAI** é uma plataforma de **monitoramento e inventário de infraestrutura de rede** pensada para equipes de engenharia e NOC. Combina: - Scan de sub-rede com **Nmap configurável** (perfis quick → aggressive) - Inventário **ativo + inativo** em sub-rede completa (`/24`) - **Mapa de topologia** interativo (React Flow) com vista **3D** - Hub operacional **Zion** — painéis por IP/métrica (CPU, RAM, disco, temperatura…) - Coleta **WMI** (Windows) + **SNMP**, alertas multicanal e relatórios - Paginação no dashboard (eventos 10/100 · dispositivos 10/2500) - Roadmap de **estabilização** (Fase 0+) além das fases enterprise 15–21 --- ## Quick Start ### Pré-requisitos - [Docker Desktop](https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/) - Docker Compose v2 ### Subir em 3 comandos ```bash git clone https://github.com/CanonEngineer/SentinelAI.git cd SentinelAI cp .env.example .env && docker compose up --build -d ``` ### Acessar | Serviço | URL | Credenciais | |---------|-----|-------------| | **Frontend** | http://localhost:5173 | `admin` / `admin123` | | **API + Swagger** | http://localhost:8000/docs | JWT após login | | **PostgreSQL** | `localhost:5432` | ver `.env.example` | | **Redis** | `localhost:6379` | — | ### Primeiro scan 1. Login no dashboard 2. Informe a sub-rede (ex: `172.20.100.0/24`) 3. Escolha perfil **Padrão** (nmap + SNMP + inventário full subnet) 4. Clique **Escanear sub-rede** 5. Acompanhe **Total · Ativos · Inativos** em tempo real --- ## Árvore do Conhecimento Mapa **2D** e **Galaxy 3D** deste projeto (balões, modal de código) no hub central: **[SentinelAI na Tree of Knowledge](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/index.html?tree=sentinelai)** · [Hub completo](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/) --- ## Arquitetura ### Visão geral (C4 — Container) ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph Clients WEB[React SPA :5173] MOB[Expo Mobile] DESK[Electron Desktop] end subgraph Platform["SentinelAI Platform"] API[FastAPI :8000] FE[Vite Frontend] CW[Celery Worker] DW[Discovery Worker] BEAT[Celery Beat] end subgraph Data PG[(PostgreSQL 16)] RD[(Redis 7)] end subgraph External NM[Nmap / ICMP] SNMP[SNMP Agents] LDAP[LDAP / AD] end WEB --> FE --> API MOB --> API DESK --> FE API --> PG API --> RD CW --> PG DW --> PG DW --> RD BEAT --> RD DW --> NM DW --> SNMP API --> LDAP ``` ### Stack tecnológica | Camada | Tecnologias | |--------|-------------| | **Frontend** | React 18, Vite, TypeScript, React Flow, Lucide | | **Backend** | FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Pydantic v2, Alembic | | **Async** | Celery, Redis, filas `celery` + `discovery` | | **Discovery** | Nmap, python-nmap, SNMP (pysnmp), ICMP ping | | **Data** | PostgreSQL, JSONB (scan_options, extra_data) | | **Deploy** | Docker Compose, Helm, GitHub Actions CI | | **Observability** | Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry (opcional) | --- ## Discovery Engine ![Pipeline de Discovery](docs/assets/discovery-pipeline.png) ### Pipeline de scan ```mermaid flowchart LR A[POST /api/discovery] --> B{Job #1–100} B --> C[Celery discovery-worker] C --> D[Nmap / ICMP ping] D --> E[Hosts vivos] E --> F{Inventário} F --> G[SNMP + DNS enrich] F --> H[Marcar inativos] G --> I[(devices)] H --> I I --> J[Job completed] J --> K[UI: Total · Ativos · Inativos] ``` ### Perfis de scan | Perfil | Nmap | SNMP | Inventário /24 | |--------|------|------|----------------| | **Rápido** | Ping + top ports | Opcional | Não | | **Padrão** | SYN + scripts | Sim | Sim (ativos + inativos) | | **Profundo** | OS + UDP | Sim | Sim | | **Agressivo** | Timing T4/T5 | Sim | Sim | | **Personalizado** | UI avançada | Configurável | Configurável | ### Ciclo de jobs Os jobs de discovery usam IDs **#1 a #100**. Ao concluir o **#100**, o próximo scan reinicia em **#1** (histórico limpo, sequência resetada). --- ## Topologia 2D & 3D ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph Map2D["Mapa 2D — React Flow"] RF[Nodes + Edges] LLDP[LLDP/CDP auto] MAN[Links manuais] ELK[Auto-layout ELK] EXP[Export PNG/SVG/PDF/VSDX] end subgraph Map3D["Mapa 3D — Map3DView"] CSS[CSS 3D transforms] H[Altura por status] TRF[Tráfego animado] end TOPO[topology_service] --> Map2D TOPO --> Map3D SNMP2[SNMP counters] --> TRF ``` - **2D**: editor completo estilo *The Dude++* — drag-drop, camadas, grupos, colaboração WebSocket - **3D**: projeção com altura por status (`active` / `inactive`) e links com tráfego SNMP --- ## Monitoramento & Alertas ```mermaid flowchart LR DEV[Devices] --> MON[Monitors] MON --> PING[ICMP Ping] MON --> HTTP[HTTP/HTTPS] MON --> TCP[TCP Port] MON --> SNMP2[SNMP Poll] PING & HTTP & TCP & SNMP2 --> MET[(metrics)] MET --> ANO[Anomaly AI] MET --> ALT[Alert Engine] ALT --> EM[Email] ALT --> TG[Telegram] ALT --> SL[Slack] ALT --> DC[Discord] ALT --> TM[Teams] ALT --> WH[Webhook] ``` --- ## Estrutura do repositório ``` SentinelAI/ ├── backend/app/ │ ├── api/routes/ # REST + WebSocket │ ├── engines/ │ │ ├── discovery/ # Nmap, SNMP, scan_options, subnet_scanner │ │ ├── monitor/ # Ping, HTTP, TCP │ │ ├── alerts/ # Multicanal │ │ ├── ai/ # Anomalias, Copilot, vision │ │ └── reporting/ # PDF, Excel, VSDX │ ├── models/ # SQLAlchemy ORM │ ├── services/ # Regras de negócio │ └── workers/ # Celery tasks ├── frontend/src/ │ ├── pages/ # Dashboard, TopologyMap, Alerts… │ ├── components/ # Discovery, Map3D, charts │ └── api/ # Cliente HTTP tipado ├── docs/ │ ├── assets/ # Ilustrações README │ └── PHASE-*-ROADMAP.md ├── deploy/helm/ # Kubernetes ├── mobile/ # React Native (Expo) ├── docker-compose.yml └── .github/workflows/ci.yml ``` --- ## API Documentação interativa: **http://localhost:8000/docs** | Endpoint | Descrição | |----------|-----------| | `POST /api/auth/login` | JWT | | `GET/POST /api/discovery` | Jobs de scan | | `GET /api/discovery/scan-defaults` | Perfis e limites | | `GET/POST /api/devices` | Inventário | | `GET /api/topology/graph` | Grafo 2D/3D | | `GET /api/events` | Timeline | | `GET /health` | Health check | --- ## Desenvolvimento local ### Backend ```bash cd backend python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\activate # Windows pip install -r requirements.txt uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 ``` ### Frontend ```bash cd frontend npm install && npm run dev ``` ### Workers ```bash cd backend celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker -Q celery,discovery -l info ``` --- ## Configuração Copie `.env.example` → `.env`. Principais variáveis: ```env # Discovery SNMP_COMMUNITY=public DISCOVERY_DEFAULT_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24 DISCOVERY_JOBS_MAX_ID=100 # Alertas ALERT_CHANNELS_ENABLED=email,telegram,slack,webhook # LDAP (opcional) LDAP_ENABLED=false ``` --- ## Roadmap

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

  api:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --timeout-graceful-shutdown 3
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - reports_data:/app/reports
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
      - "2055:2055/udp"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "python -c \"import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/health')\""]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW

  worker:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=4 -Q celery
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - reports_data:/app/reports
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW

  discovery-worker:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=2 -Q discovery
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - reports_data:/app/reports
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW

  beat:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: celery -A app.workers.celery_app beat --loglevel=info
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
    depends_on:
      - worker
      - redis

  frontend:
    build:
      context: ./frontend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: sh -c "rm -rf node_modules/.vite && npm install && npm run dev"
    ports:
      - "5173:5173"
    volumes:
      - ./frontend:/app
      - /app/node_modules
    environment:
      # Vazio = browser usa /api via proxy Vite (mesma origem, sem CORS, reconecta após restart da API)
      VITE_API_URL: ""
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy

import time

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.config import settings
from app.database import get_db
from app.dependencies import require_operator, require_viewer
from app.engines.discovery.dns_resolver import iter_host_addresses, validate_subnet
from app.models import DiscoveryJob, DiscoveryJobStatus, User
from app.engines.discovery.scan_options import list_scan_defaults, resolve_scan_options
from app.schemas.discovery import (
    DiscoveryJobCreate,
    DiscoveryJobResponse,
    ScanDefaultsResponse,
)
from app.services.discovery_service import (
    cycle_discovery_job_ids_if_needed,
    fail_stuck_pending_discovery_jobs,
    fail_orphaned_discovery_jobs,
    fail_stale_discovery_jobs,
    has_active_discovery_job,
    prune_discovery_jobs,
    reconcile_cancelled_discovery_jobs,
    stop_discovery_job,
)
from app.workers.discovery_tasks import run_discovery_job

router = APIRouter()

MAX_JOBS = settings.discovery_jobs_max_history
_RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30.0
_last_reconcile_monotonic = 0.0


def _maybe_reconcile_discovery_jobs() -> None:
    """Reconcilia jobs órfãos/stale no máximo a cada 30s (evita esgotar pool no polling)."""
    global _last_reconcile_monotonic
    now = time.monotonic()
    if now - _last_reconcile_monotonic < _RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS:
        return
    _last_reconcile_monotonic = now

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    with SyncSession() as session:
        stale = fail_stale_discovery_jobs(session)
        stuck = fail_stuck_pending_discovery_jobs(session)
        orphaned = fail_orphaned_discovery_jobs(session)
        reconciled = reconcile_cancelled_discovery_jobs(session)
        if stale or stuck or orphaned or reconciled:
            session.commit()


@router.get("", response_model=list[DiscoveryJobResponse])
async def list_discovery_jobs(
    limit: int = MAX_JOBS,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    cap = min(max(limit, 1), MAX_JOBS)

    _maybe_reconcile_discovery_jobs()

    result = await db.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).order_by(DiscoveryJob.created_at.desc()).limit(cap)
    )
    return result.scalars().all()


@router.get("/scan-defaults", response_model=ScanDefaultsResponse)
async def get_scan_defaults(_: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    return list_scan_defaults()


def _build_scan_options_payload(payload: DiscoveryJobCreate) -> dict:
    if payload.scan_options:
        opts = payload.scan_options.model_dump(exclude_none=True)
    else:
        opts = {"profile": "standard"}

    if payload.scan_options is None or payload.scan_options.use_snmp is None:
        opts["use_snmp"] = payload.use_snmp
    community = payload.snmp_community or opts.get("snmp_community")
    if community:
        opts["snmp_community"] = community
    return opts


@router.post("", response_model=DiscoveryJobResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED)
async def start_discovery(
    payload: DiscoveryJobCreate,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    try:
        validate_subnet(payload.subnet)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    with SyncSession() as session:
        if has_active_discovery_job(session):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail="Já existe um scan em andamento. Cancele-o antes de iniciar outro.",
            )
        cycle_discovery_job_ids_if_needed(session)
        session.commit()

    scan_opts_dict = _build_scan_options_payload(payload)
    resolved = resolve_scan_options(
        scan_opts_dict,
        snmp_community_fallback=payload.snmp_community or settings.snmp_community,
    )

    job = DiscoveryJob(
        subnet=payload.subnet,
        use_snmp=resolved.use_snmp,
        snmp_community=resolved.snmp_community,
        scan_options=scan_opts_dict,
        status=DiscoveryJobStatus.PENDING,
        progress_percent=0,
        progress_label=f"Aguardando worker · perfil {resolved.label}",
        hosts_processed=0,
        devices_found=0,
        devices_inactive=0,
        total_hosts=len(iter_host_addresses(payload.subnet)),
    )
    db.add(job)
    await db.flush()

    async_result = run_discovery_job.apply_async(args=[job.id], queue="discovery", priority=9)
    job.celery_task_id = async_result.id
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(job)

    with SyncSession() as session:
        prune_discovery_jobs(session, keep=MAX_JOBS)
        session.commit()

    return job


@router.post("/{job_id}/stop", response_model=DiscoveryJobResponse)
async def stop_discovery(
    job_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    job = await db.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Job não encontrado")

    if job.status in (DiscoveryJobStatus.COMPLETED, DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED):
        return job

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    with SyncSession() as session:
        sync_job = session.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
        if not sync_job:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Job não encontrado")
        stop_discovery_job(session, sync_job)
        session.commit()
        session.refresh(sync_job)
        response = DiscoveryJobResponse.model_validate(sync_job)

    return response


@router.get("/{job_id}", response_model=DiscoveryJobResponse)
async def get_discovery_job(
    job_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    job = await db.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Job não encontrado")
    return job

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from app.engines.discovery.nmap_scanner import (
    ScanCancelledError,
    ScanTimeoutError,
    nmap_available,
    scan_subnet_nmap,
)
from app.engines.discovery.subnet_scanner import scan_subnet
from app.engines.discovery.discovery_progress import NMAP_MAX_PERCENT
from app.engines.discovery.dns_resolver import iter_host_addresses
from app.engines.discovery.scan_options import resolve_scan_options
from app.models import Device, DeviceStatus, DiscoveryJob, DiscoveryJobStatus, Metric, Monitor, MonitorType
from app.engines.discovery.snmp_collector import collect_snmp_info
from app.services.discovery_service import is_job_cancelled
from app.services.inventory_service import process_discovery_results
from app.services.traffic_service import sync_link_traffic, update_device_interface_counters
from app.workers.celery_app import celery_app
from app.db_sync import SyncSession
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session


def _update_job_progress(
    session: Session,
    job: DiscoveryJob,
    percent: int,
    label: str,
    *,
    hosts_processed: int | None = None,
    devices_found: int | None = None,
    devices_inactive: int | None = None,
) -> None:
    session.expire(job)
    if job.cancel_requested or job.status != DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING:
        raise ScanCancelledError("Scan cancelado pelo usuário")

    job.progress_percent = min(100, max(0, percent))
    job.progress_label = label
    if hosts_processed is not None:
        job.hosts_processed = hosts_processed
    if devices_found is not None:
        job.devices_found = devices_found
    if devices_inactive is not None:
        job.devices_inactive = devices_inactive
    session.commit()


def _ensure_job_still_running(session: Session, job: DiscoveryJob) -> None:
    session.expire(job)
    if job.cancel_requested or job.status != DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING:
        raise ScanCancelledError("Scan cancelado pelo usuário")


def _fail_job(session: Session, job: DiscoveryJob, message: str, *, cancelled: bool = False) -> None:
    job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
    job.error_message = message
    job.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    job.progress_label = "Scan cancelado" if cancelled else "Scan falhou"
    session.commit()


@celery_app.task(
    name="app.workers.discovery_tasks.run_discovery_job",
    bind=True,
    time_limit=3600,
    soft_time_limit=3300,
)
def run_discovery_job(self, job_id: int) -> dict:
    import asyncio

    from app.config import settings

    with SyncSession() as session:
        job = session.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
        if not job:
            return {"error": "job not found"}

        if job.cancel_requested:
            _fail_job(session, job, "Scan cancelado pelo usuário", cancelled=True)
            return {"job_id": job_id, "cancelled": True}

        job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING
        job.started_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        job.progress_percent = 0
        job.progress_label = "Iniciando scan..."
        job.hosts_processed = 0
        job.devices_found = 0
        job.devices_inactive = 0
        job.total_hosts = len(iter_host_addresses(job.subnet))
        job.celery_task_id = self.request.id
        session.commit()

"""Scan de rede via nmap (descoberta + portas/serviços/OS)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from app.config import settings
from app.engines.discovery.discovery_progress import nmap_percent, nmap_range_percent
from app.engines.discovery.dns_resolver import iter_host_addresses
from app.engines.discovery.scan_options import ResolvedScanOptions, resolve_scan_options

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]
CancelCallback = Callable[[], bool]


class ScanCancelledError(Exception):
    """Scan interrompido pelo usuário."""


class ScanTimeoutError(Exception):
    """Scan excedeu tempo máximo permitido."""


@dataclass
class NmapHost:
    ip_address: str
    hostname: str | None = None
    mac_address: str | None = None
    vendor: str | None = None
    os_name: str | None = None
    open_ports: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class NmapScanResult:
    alive_hosts: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    hosts: dict[str, NmapHost] = field(default_factory=dict)
    total_hosts: int = 0
    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


def nmap_available() -> bool:
    return shutil.which(settings.nmap_path) is not None


def _format_elapsed(seconds: float) -> str:
    total = int(seconds)
    if total < 60:
        return f"{total}s"
    minutes, secs = divmod(total, 60)
    if minutes < 60:
        return f"{minutes}m {secs}s"
    hours, minutes = divmod(minutes, 60)
    return f"{hours}h {minutes}m"


def _common_nmap_args() -> list[str]:
    return [
        "-n",
        "--host-timeout",
        settings.nmap_host_timeout,
        "--max-retries",
        str(settings.nmap_max_retries),
    ]


def _parse_nmap_xml(xml_text: str) -> dict[str, NmapHost]:
    hosts: dict[str, NmapHost] = {}
    if not xml_text.strip():
        return hosts

    root = ET.fromstring(xml_text)
    for host_el in root.findall("host"):
        status = host_el.find("status")
        if status is not None and status.get("state") != "up":
            continue

        ip: str | None = None
        mac: str | None = None
        vendor: str | None = None
        for addr in host_el.findall("address"):
            if addr.get("addrtype") == "ipv4":
                ip = addr.get("addr")
            elif addr.get("addrtype") == "mac":
                mac = addr.get("addr")
                vendor = addr.get("vendor")

        if not ip:
            continue

        hostname: str | None = None
        hostnames = host_el.find("hostnames")
        if hostnames is not None:
            for hn in hostnames.findall("hostname"):
                name = hn.get("name")
                if name:
                    hostname = name
                    break

        os_name: str | None = None
        os_el = host_el.find("os")
        if os_el is not None:
            matches = os_el.findall("osmatch")
            if matches:
                os_name = matches[0].get("name")

        open_ports: list[dict] = []
        ports_el = host_el.find("ports")
        if ports_el is not None:
            for port_el in ports_el.findall("port"):
                state_el = port_el.find("state")
                if state_el is None or state_el.get("state") != "open":
                    continue
                service_el = port_el.find("service")
                open_ports.append(
                    {
                        "port": int(port_el.get("portid", 0)),
                        "protocol": port_el.get("protocol", "tcp"),
                        "service": service_el.get("name") if service_el is not None else None,
                        "product": service_el.get("product") if service_el is not None else None,
                        "version": service_el.get("version") if service_el is not None else None,
                    }
                )

        hosts[ip] = NmapHost(
            ip_address=ip,
            hostname=hostname,
            mac_address=mac,
            vendor=vendor,
            os_name=os_name,
            open_ports=open_ports,
        )

    return hosts


def _merge_hosts(result: NmapScanResult, parsed: dict[str, NmapHost]) -> None:
    for ip, host in parsed.items():
        base = result.hosts.get(ip)
        if base:
            base.hostname = host.hostname or base.hostname
            base.mac_address = host.mac_address or base.mac_address
            base.vendor = host.vendor or base.vendor
            base.os_name = host.os_name or base.os_name
            base.open_ports = host.open_ports or base.open_ports
        else:
            result.hosts[ip] = host
            if ip not in result.alive_hosts:
                result.alive_hosts.append(ip)


def _terminate_process(proc: subprocess.Popen[bytes]) -> None:
    proc.terminate()
    try:
        proc.wait(timeout=5)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        proc.kill()
        proc.wait(timeout=5)


def _run_nmap(
    args: list[str],
    *,
    on_progress: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    should_cancel: CancelCallback | None = None,
    progress_start: int = 0,
    progress_end: int = 100,
    progress_label: str = "nmap",
    timeout_seconds: int | None = None,
) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    cmd = [settings.nmap_path, *args]
    errors: list[str] = []
    xml_chunks: list[str] = []

    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".xml", delete=False) as tmp:
        xml_path = tmp.name

    cmd.extend(["-oX", xml_path])

    try:
        proc = subprocess.Popen(
            cmd,
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )

        started = time.monotonic()
        last_heartbeat = 0.0
        span = max(progress_end - progress_start, 1)

        while proc.poll() is None:
            if should_cancel and should_cancel():
                _terminate_process(proc)
                raise ScanCancelledError("Scan cancelado pelo usuário")

            now = time.monotonic()
            elapsed = now - started

            if timeout_seconds is not None and elapsed > timeout_seconds:
                _terminate_process(proc)
                raise ScanTimeoutError(
                    f"{progress_label} excedeu {timeout_seconds}s (limite de tempo)"
                )

            heartbeat = settings.nmap_progress_heartbeat_seconds
            if on_progress and (now - last_heartbeat) >= heartbeat:
                last_heartbeat = now
                if timeout_seconds:
                    ratio = min(0.95, elapsed / timeout_seconds)
                else:
                    ratio = min(0.95, elapsed / 300)
                pct = progress_start + int(span * ratio)
                on_progress(
                    pct,
                    f"{progress_label} · {_format_elapsed(elapsed)}",
                )

            time.sleep(0.4)

        if proc.returncode not in (0, 1):
            errors.append(f"nmap exit code {proc.returncode}")

        with open(xml_path, encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as fh:
            xml_chunks.append(fh.read())
    finally:
        try:
            os.unlink(xml_path)
        except OSError:
            pass

    if on_progress:
        on_progress(progress_end, f"{progress_label} · concluído")

    return "".join(xml_chunks), errors


def _detail_scan_args(hosts: list[str], opts: ResolvedScanOptions, *, heavy: bool) -> list[str]:
    scan_flag = {"syn": "-sS", "connect": "-sT", "ack": "-sA"}.get(opts.scan_type, "-sS")
    args = [scan_flag, f"-T{opts.timing}", "--open", *_common_nmap_args()]

    if heavy and opts.service_detection:
        args.append("-sV")
    if heavy and opts.os_detection:
        args.append("-O")
    if heavy and opts.script_scan:
        args.append("-sC")

    if opts.port_range:
        args.extend(["-p", opts.port_range])
    elif opts.top_ports > 0:
        port_count = opts.top_ports if heavy else min(opts.top_ports, settings.nmap_light_top_ports)
        args.extend(["--top-ports", str(port_count)])

    args.extend(hosts)
    return args


def _udp_scan_args(hosts: list[str], opts: ResolvedScanOptions) -> list[str]:
    return [
        "-sU",
        f"-T{opts.timing}",
        "--open",
        "--top-ports",
        "100",
        *_common_nmap_args(),
        *hosts,
    ]


def _is_suspicious_alive_count(alive_count: int, total_hosts: int, opts: ResolvedScanOptions) -> bool:
    return (
        not opts.skip_suspicious_check
        and total_hosts >= 16
        and alive_count >= int(total_hosts * opts.suspicious_alive_ratio)
    )


def _resolve_alive_with_ping(
    cidr: str,
    nmap_alive: list[str],
    discovered: dict[str, NmapHost],
    result: NmapScanResult,
    opts: ResolvedScanOptions,
    *,
    on_progress: ProgressCallback | None,
    should_cancel: CancelCallback | None,
) -> list[str]:
    """Confirma hosts com ICMP; em rede suspeita faz ping em todo o /24."""
    import asyncio

    from app.engines.discovery.subnet_scanner import scan_subnet

    if not opts.ping_verify:
        return nmap_alive

    nmap_count = len(nmap_alive)

    def ping_progress(pct: int, label: str) -> None:
        if on_progress:
            mapped = nmap_percent(0.35 + 0.25 * (pct / 100))
            on_progress(mapped, label)

    if on_progress:
        on_progress(
            nmap_percent(0.35),
            f"Ping ICMP em {cidr} (confirmando hosts ativos)",
        )
    ping_result = asyncio.run(
        scan_subnet(
            cidr,
            batch_size=settings.discovery_batch_size,
            on_progress=ping_progress,
        )
    )
    verified = sorted(ping_result.alive_hosts)
    if nmap_count and len(verified) != nmap_count:
        result.errors.append(
            f"Ping ICMP: {len(verified)} ativos na sub-rede"
            + (f" (nmap reportou {nmap_count})" if nmap_count != len(verified) else "")
        )
    result.hosts = {
        ip: discovered.get(ip) or NmapHost(ip_address=ip)
        for ip in verified
    }
    return verified


def scan_subnet_nmap(
    cidr: str,
    *,
    scan_options: ResolvedScanOptions | None = None,
    on_progress: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    should_cancel: CancelCallback | None = None,
) -> NmapScanResult:
    """Scan nmap configurável: descoberta + portas/serviços/OS/scripts + UDP opcional."""
    opts = scan_options or resolve_scan_options(None)
    result = NmapScanResult(total_hosts=len(iter_host_addresses(cidr)))

    if not nmap_available():
        result.errors.append("nmap não encontrado no PATH")
        return result

    if should_cancel and should_cancel():
        raise ScanCancelledError("Scan cancelado pelo usuário")

    if on_progress:
        on_progress(0, f"nmap · descoberta ({opts.label}) em {cidr}")

    discover_args = [
        "-sn",
        f"-T{opts.timing}",
        "--min-rate",

    ]
    xml_discover, err_discover = _run_nmap(
        discover_args,
        on_progress=on_progress,
        should_cancel=should_cancel,
        progress_start=0,
        progress_end=3,
        progress_label="nmap descoberta",
        timeout_seconds=opts.discover_timeout_seconds,
    )
    result.errors.extend(err_discover)

    if should_cancel and should_cancel():

    discovered = _parse_nmap_xml(xml_discover)

        cidr,

    result.alive_hosts = alive

    if should_cancel and should_cancel():

    if not alive:
        if on_progress:

import asyncio
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from icmplib import async_multiping

from app.config import settings
from app.engines.discovery.dns_resolver import iter_host_addresses

ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]


@dataclass
class ScanResult:
    alive_hosts: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    total_hosts: int = 0
    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


async def ping_batch(hosts: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    if not hosts:
        return []

    try:
        results = await async_multiping(
            hosts,
            count=1,
            timeout=settings.ping_timeout_seconds,
            privileged=False,
        )
        return [result.address for result in results if result.is_alive]
    except Exception:
        return []


async def ping_hosts(
    hosts: list[str],
    *,
    batch_size: int | None = None,
    on_progress: ProgressCallback | None = None,
) -> list[str]:
    """Confirma hosts vivos via ICMP (filtra falsos positivos do nmap)."""
    if not hosts:
        return []

    batch_size = batch_size or settings.discovery_batch_size
    alive: list[str] = []
    total_batches = max(1, (len(hosts) + batch_size - 1) // batch_size)

    for batch_num, index in enumerate(range(0, len(hosts), batch_size)):
        batch = hosts[index : index + batch_size]
        alive.extend(await ping_batch(batch))
        if on_progress:
            pct = int(100 * (batch_num + 1) / total_batches)
            on_progress(
                pct,
                f"Ping {batch_num + 1}/{total_batches} · {len(alive)} confirmados",
            )
        await asyncio.sleep(0.02)

    return alive


async def scan_subnet(
    cidr: str,
    batch_size: int = 64,
    on_progress: ProgressCallback | None = None,
) -> ScanResult:
    hosts = iter_host_addresses(cidr)
    result = ScanResult(total_hosts=len(hosts))
    total_batches = max(1, (len(hosts) + batch_size - 1) // batch_size)

    if on_progress:
        on_progress(5, f"Ping 0/{total_batches} · {result.total_hosts} hosts na sub-rede")

    for batch_num, index in enumerate(range(0, len(hosts), batch_size)):
        batch = hosts[index : index + batch_size]
        try:
            alive = await ping_batch(batch)
            result.alive_hosts.extend(alive)
        except Exception as exc:
            result.errors.append(str(exc))

        if on_progress:
            pct = 5 + int(40 * (batch_num + 1) / total_batches)
            on_progress(
                pct,
                f"Ping {batch_num + 1}/{total_batches} · {len(result.alive_hosts)} ativos",
            )
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)

    return result

def _snmp_get(host: str, oid: str, community: str | None = None) -> str | None:
    community = community or settings.snmp_community
    iterator = getCmd(
        SnmpEngine(),
        CommunityData(community, mpModel=1),
        UdpTransportTarget((host, settings.snmp_port), timeout=settings.snmp_timeout_seconds, retries=1),
        ContextData(),
        ObjectType(ObjectIdentity(oid)),
    )
    error_indication, error_status, _, var_binds = next(iterator)
    if error_indication or error_status:
        return None
    return str(var_binds[0][1])


def _snmp_walk(host: str, oid: str, community: str | None = None, limit: int = 32) -> list[str]:
    community = community or settings.snmp_community
    values: list[str] = []
    iterator = nextCmd(
        SnmpEngine(),
        CommunityData(community, mpModel=1),
        UdpTransportTarget((host, settings.snmp_port), timeout=settings.snmp_timeout_seconds, retries=1),
        ContextData(),
        ObjectType(ObjectIdentity(oid)),
        lexicographicMode=False,
    )
    for error_indication, error_status, _, var_binds in iterator:
        if error_indication or error_status:

        values.append(str(var_binds[0][1]))
        if len(values) >= limit:

def parse_sys_descr(sys_descr: str | None) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
    if not sys_descr:
        return None, None

    lower = sys_descr.lower()
    vendor: str | None = None
    for hint, name in VENDOR_HINTS:
        if hint in lower:
            vendor = name
            break

    model: str | None = None
    cisco_model = re.search(r"\(([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9\-_]+(?:K9|M)?)\)", sys_descr)
    if cisco_model:
        model = cisco_model.group(1)
    if not model:
        mikrotik_model = re.search(r"routeros[^)]*\)\s+(\S+)", sys_descr, re.IGNORECASE)
        if mikrotik_model:
            model = mikrotik_model.group(1)
    if not model:
        hp_model = re.search(r"HP[^\n,]*?([A-Z]{1,3}\d{3,}[A-Z0-9\-]*)", sys_descr, re.IGNORECASE)
        if hp_model:
            model = hp_model.group(1)
    if not model:
        generic = re.search(r"(?:model|prod|product)[:\s]+([^\s,;]+)", sys_descr, re.IGNORECASE)
        if generic:
            model = generic.group(1)

    return vendor, model


def format_mac_address(raw) -> str | None:
    if raw is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(raw, (bytes, bytearray)):
        if len(raw) != 6 or not any(b for b in raw):
            return None
        return ":".join(f"{b:02X}" for b in raw)

    text = str(raw).strip().upper()
    if not text or text in {"00:00:00:00:00:00", "0:0:0:0:0:0"}:
        return None

    hex_only = re.sub(r"[^0-9A-F]", "", text)
    if len(hex_only) == 12:
        return ":".join(hex_only[i : i + 2] for i in range(0, 12, 2))

    normalized = text.replace("-", ":")
    if re.fullmatch(r"([0-9A-F]{2}:){5}[0-9A-F]{2}", normalized):
        return normalized
    return None


def _collect_mac_address(host: str, community: str) -> str | None:
    for raw in _snmp_walk(host, IF_PHYS_ADDRESS, community, limit=32):
        mac = format_mac_address(raw)
        if mac:
            return mac
    return None


def collect_snmp_info(host: str, community: str | None = None) -> SnmpDeviceInfo:
    communities = [community] if community else settings.snmp_communities_list
    last_error: str | None = None

    for candidate in communities:
        info = _collect_snmp_info_with_community(host, candidate)
        if info.reachable:
            return info
        last_error = info.error

    fallback = SnmpDeviceInfo()
    fallback.error = last_error or "SNMP unreachable or community invalid"
    return fallback


def _collect_snmp_info_with_community(host: str, community: str) -> SnmpDeviceInfo:
    info = SnmpDeviceInfo()
    community = community or settings.snmp_community

    try:
        sys_name = _snmp_get(host, SYS_NAME, community)
        if sys_name is None:
            info.error = "SNMP unreachable or community invalid"
            return info

        info.reachable = True
        info.sys_name = sys_name
        info.sys_descr = _snmp_get(host, SYS_DESCR, community)
        info.sys_location = _snmp_get(host, SYS_LOCATION, community)
        info.sys_uptime = _snmp_get(host, SYS_UPTIME, community)
        info.vendor, info.model = parse_sys_descr(info.sys_descr)
        info.mac_address = _collect_mac_address(host, community)

        if if_number := _snmp_get(host, IF_NUMBER, community):
            if if_number.isdigit():
                info.interface_count = int(if_number)

        cpu_values = _snmp_walk(host, HR_PROCESSOR_LOAD, community, limit=16)
        info.cpu_loads = [float(value) for value in cpu_values if value.isdigit() or _is_float(value)]
        if info.cpu_loads:
            info.cpu_load = round(sum(info.cpu_loads) / len(info.cpu_loads), 2)

        _collect_storage_and_temp(host, community, info)
        info.interfaces = _collect_interfaces(host, community)
        _collect_ups(host, community, info)
    except Exception as exc:
        info.error = str(exc)

    return info


def _collect_ups(host: str, community: str, info: SnmpDeviceInfo) -> None:

"""Operações de jobs de discovery (limite de histórico, cancelamento)."""

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import delete, func, select, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.config import settings
from app.models import DiscoveryJob, DiscoveryJobStatus

MAX_DISCOVERY_JOBS = 3


def cycle_discovery_job_ids_if_needed(session: Session) -> bool:
    """Reinicia a numeração dos jobs (1…max) quando o último ID atinge o limite."""
    max_id = session.execute(select(func.max(DiscoveryJob.id))).scalar() or 0
    if max_id < settings.discovery_jobs_max_id:
        return False

    session.execute(delete(DiscoveryJob))
    session.execute(text("ALTER SEQUENCE discovery_jobs_id_seq RESTART WITH 1"))
    return True


def prune_discovery_jobs(session: Session, keep: int = MAX_DISCOVERY_JOBS) -> int:
    """Mantém apenas os `keep` jobs mais recentes; remove os mais antigos."""
    jobs = session.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).order_by(DiscoveryJob.created_at.desc(), DiscoveryJob.id.desc())
    ).scalars().all()
    removed = 0
    for old in jobs[keep:]:
        if old.status in (DiscoveryJobStatus.PENDING, DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING):
            stop_discovery_job(session, old)
        session.delete(old)
        removed += 1
    return removed


def stop_discovery_job(session: Session, job: DiscoveryJob) -> DiscoveryJob:
    """Solicita parada do scan e revoga a task Celery associada."""
    if job.status in (DiscoveryJobStatus.COMPLETED, DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED):
        return job

    job.cancel_requested = True

    if job.celery_task_id:
        from app.workers.celery_app import celery_app

        celery_app.control.revoke(job.celery_task_id, terminate=True, signal="SIGKILL")

    job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
    job.error_message = "Scan cancelado pelo usuário"
    job.progress_label = "Scan cancelado"
    job.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    session.add(job)
    return job


def is_job_cancelled(session: Session, job_id: int) -> bool:
    job = session.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
    if not job:
        return True
    return bool(job.cancel_requested) or job.status == DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED


def has_active_discovery_job(session: Session) -> bool:
    job = session.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob.id)
        .where(DiscoveryJob.status.in_((DiscoveryJobStatus.PENDING, DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING)))
        .limit(1)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    return job is not None


def reconcile_cancelled_discovery_jobs(session: Session) -> int:
    """Garante que jobs com cancel_requested não permaneçam como RUNNING."""
    jobs = session.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).where(
            DiscoveryJob.status == DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING,
            DiscoveryJob.cancel_requested.is_(True),
        )
    ).scalars().all()

    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    fixed = 0
    for job in jobs:
        job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
        job.error_message = job.error_message or "Scan cancelado pelo usuário"
        job.progress_label = "Scan cancelado"
        job.completed_at = job.completed_at or now
        fixed += 1
    return fixed


def fail_stale_discovery_jobs(session: Session) -> int:
    """Marca como falha jobs RUNNING/PENDING parados além do tempo máximo."""
    cutoff = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(seconds=settings.discovery_job_stale_seconds)
    jobs = session.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).where(
            DiscoveryJob.status.in_((DiscoveryJobStatus.PENDING, DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING)),
            DiscoveryJob.started_at.is_not(None),
            DiscoveryJob.started_at < cutoff,
        )
    ).scalars().all()

    failed = 0
    for job in jobs:
        job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
        job.error_message = f"Scan expirou após {settings.discovery_job_stale_seconds // 60} min sem concluir"
        job.progress_label = "Scan falhou"
        job.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        failed += 1
    return failed


def fail_stuck_pending_discovery_jobs(session: Session) -> int:
    """Marca como falha jobs PENDING que nunca foram iniciados pelo worker."""
    cutoff = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(seconds=90)
    jobs = session.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).where(
            DiscoveryJob.status == DiscoveryJobStatus.PENDING,
            DiscoveryJob.started_at.is_(None),
            DiscoveryJob.created_at < cutoff,
        )
    ).scalars().all()

    failed = 0
    for job in jobs:
        job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
        job.error_message = "Scan não iniciou — worker indisponível ou fila cheia"
        job.progress_label = "Scan falhou"
        job.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        failed += 1
    return failed


def fail_orphaned_discovery_jobs(session: Session) -> int:
    """Marca como falha jobs RUNNING cuja task Celery não está mais ativa."""
    from celery.result import AsyncResult

    from app.workers.celery_app import celery_app

    jobs = session.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).where(DiscoveryJob.status == DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING)
    ).scalars().all()
    if not jobs:
        return 0

    active_ids: set[str] = set()
    inspect = celery_app.control.inspect(timeout=2.0)
    if inspect:
        for bucket in (inspect.active() or {}, inspect.reserved() or {}, inspect.scheduled() or {}):
            for task_list in bucket.values():
                for task in task_list or []:
                    task_id = task.get("id")
                    if task_id:
                        active_ids.add(task_id)

    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    min_age = timedelta(seconds=30)
    orphan_age = timedelta(seconds=45)
    failed = 0

    for job in jobs:
        if not job.started_at or (now - job.started_at) < min_age:
            continue

        if not job.celery_task_id:
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
            job.error_message = "Scan perdido (sem task Celery associada)"
            job.progress_label = "Scan falhou"
            job.completed_at = now
            failed += 1
            continue

        if job.celery_task_id in active_ids:
            continue

        result = AsyncResult(job.celery_task_id, app=celery_app)
        state = result.state
        if state in ("SUCCESS", "FAILURE", "REVOKED"):
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
            if state == "FAILURE" and result.result:
                job.error_message = str(result.result)[:500]
            else:
                job.error_message = "Scan interrompido antes de concluir"
            job.progress_label = "Scan falhou"
            job.completed_at = now
            failed += 1
        elif state == "PENDING" and (now - job.started_at) >= min_age:
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
            job.error_message = "Scan interrompido (worker offline ou task perdida)"
            job.progress_label = "Scan falhou"
            job.completed_at = now
            failed += 1
        elif (now - job.started_at) >= orphan_age:
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
            job.error_message = "Scan interrompido (sem resposta do worker)"
            job.progress_label = "Scan falhou"
            job.completed_at = now
            failed += 1

    return failed

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from types import SimpleNamespace

from sqlalchemy import or_, select, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.engines.topology.neighbor_collector import NeighborInfo, collect_cdp_neighbors, collect_lldp_neighbors
from app.models import Device, DeviceStatus, LinkProtocol, LinkStatus, NetworkLink, TopologyGroup, TopologyLayout
from app.services.device_service import create_device_with_monitor_sync


def _resolve_device(session: Session, neighbor: NeighborInfo) -> Device | None:
    if neighbor.remote_ip:
        device = session.execute(
            select(Device).where(Device.ip_address == neighbor.remote_ip)
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if device and device.status != DeviceStatus.RETIRED:
            return device

    if neighbor.remote_name:
        device = session.execute(
            select(Device).where(
                or_(
                    Device.hostname == neighbor.remote_name,
                    Device.hostname.ilike(neighbor.remote_name),
                )
            )
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if device and device.status != DeviceStatus.RETIRED:
            return device

        device = session.execute(
            select(Device).where(Device.hostname.ilike(f"%{neighbor.remote_name}%"))
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if device and device.status != DeviceStatus.RETIRED:
            return device
    return None


def register_neighbor_device(session: Session, neighbor: NeighborInfo) -> Device | None:
    if not neighbor.remote_ip:
        return None
    existing = session.execute(
        select(Device).where(Device.ip_address == neighbor.remote_ip)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing:
        if existing.status == DeviceStatus.RETIRED:
            return None
        return existing
    return create_device_with_monitor_sync(
        session,
        ip_address=neighbor.remote_ip,
        hostname=neighbor.remote_name,
        device_type="network_device",
    )


def _upsert_link(
    session: Session,
    source: Device,
    neighbor: NeighborInfo,
    target: Device | None,
    edge_style: str = "smoothstep",
    map_layer: str = "physical",
) -> bool:
    protocol = LinkProtocol(neighbor.protocol) if neighbor.protocol != "manual" else LinkProtocol.MANUAL
    existing = session.execute(
        select(NetworkLink).where(
            NetworkLink.source_device_id == source.id,
            NetworkLink.source_port == neighbor.local_port,
            NetworkLink.remote_hostname == neighbor.remote_name,
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()

    if existing:
        existing.target_device_id = target.id if target else existing.target_device_id
        existing.target_port = neighbor.remote_port
        existing.remote_ip = neighbor.remote_ip
        existing.protocol = protocol
        existing.status = LinkStatus.ACTIVE
        existing.updated_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        session.add(existing)
        return False

    session.add(
        NetworkLink(
            source_device_id=source.id,
            target_device_id=target.id if target else None,
            source_port=neighbor.local_port,
            target_port=neighbor.remote_port,
            remote_hostname=neighbor.remote_name,
            remote_ip=neighbor.remote_ip,
            protocol=protocol,
            status=LinkStatus.ACTIVE,
            edge_style=edge_style,
            map_layer=map_layer,
        )
    )
    return True


def discover_topology_for_device(session: Session, device: Device, community: str | None = None) -> int:
    neighbors = collect_lldp_neighbors(device.ip_address, community)
    if not neighbors:
        neighbors = collect_cdp_neighbors(device.ip_address, community)

    created = 0
    for neighbor in neighbors:
        registered = register_neighbor_device(session, neighbor)
        target = registered or _resolve_device(session, neighbor)
        if _upsert_link(session, device, neighbor, target):
            created += 1
    return created


def _normalize_handles(
    source_handle: str | None,
    target_handle: str | None,
) -> tuple[str, str]:
    valid_source = {"right", "bottom"}
    valid_target = {"top", "left"}
    sh = source_handle if source_handle in valid_source else "right"
    th = target_handle if target_handle in valid_target else "left"
    return sh, th


def create_manual_link(
    session: Session,
    source_device_id: int,
    target_device_id: int,
    label: str | None = None,
    edge_style: str = "smoothstep",
    map_layer: str = "physical",
    source_handle: str | None = None,
    target_handle: str | None = None,
) -> NetworkLink:
    source = session.get(Device, source_device_id)
    target = session.get(Device, target_device_id)
    if not source or not target:
        raise ValueError("Dispositivo origem ou destino não encontrado")

    sh, th = _normalize_handles(source_handle, target_handle)

    existing_id = session.execute(
        text(
            """
            SELECT id FROM network_links
            WHERE map_layer = :layer AND lower(protocol::text) = 'manual'
              AND source_device_id = :src AND target_device_id = :tgt
            LIMIT 1
            """
        ),
        {"layer": map_layer, "src": source.id, "tgt": target.id},
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing_id:
        session.execute(
            text(
                """
                UPDATE network_links
                SET source_handle = :sh, target_handle = :th, edge_style = :style
                WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"sh": sh, "th": th, "style": edge_style, "id": existing_id},
        )
        return SimpleNamespace(id=existing_id)

    reverse_id = session.execute(
        text(
            """
            SELECT id FROM network_links
            WHERE map_layer = :layer AND lower(protocol::text) = 'manual'
              AND source_device_id = :tgt AND target_device_id = :src
            LIMIT 1
            """
        ),
        {"layer": map_layer, "src": source.id, "tgt": target.id},
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if reverse_id:
        session.execute(
            text(
                """
                UPDATE network_links
                SET source_device_id = :src, target_device_id = :tgt,
                    source_handle = :sh, target_handle = :th, edge_style = :style
                WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"src": source.id, "tgt": target.id, "sh": sh, "th": th, "style": edge_style, "id": reverse_id},
        )
        return SimpleNamespace(id=reverse_id)

    link_id = session.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO network_links
                (source_device_id, target_device_id, source_port, protocol, status,
                 edge_style, map_layer, source_handle, target_handle)
            VALUES
                (:src, :tgt, :port, 'manual'::link_protocol, 'ACTIVE'::link_status,
                 :style, :layer, :sh, :th)
            RETURNING id
            """
        ),
        {
            "src": source.id,
            "tgt": target.id,
            "port": label or "manual",
            "style": edge_style,
            "layer": map_layer,
            "sh": sh,
            "th": th,
        },
    ).scalar_one()
    return SimpleNamespace(id=link_id)


def delete_manual_link(session: Session, link_id: int) -> None:
    deleted = session.execute(
        text(
            "DELETE FROM network_links WHERE id = :id AND lower(protocol::text) = 'manual' RETURNING id"
        ),
        {"id": link_id},
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if not deleted:
        raise ValueError("Link não encontrado")


def create_manual_group_link(
    session: Session,
    source_group_id: int,
    target_group_id: int,
    edge_style: str = "smoothstep",
    map_layer: str = "physical",
    source_handle: str | None = None,
    target_handle: str | None = None,

    from app.models import GroupType

    source = session.get(TopologyGroup, source_group_id)
    target = session.get(TopologyGroup, target_group_id)
    if not source or not target:
        raise ValueError("Departamento origem ou destino não encontrado")
    if source.group_type != GroupType.DEPARTMENT or target.group_type != GroupType.DEPARTMENT:
        raise ValueError("Só é possível ligar departamentos")
    if source.id == target.id:
        raise ValueError("Não é possível ligar um departamento a si mesmo")

    sh, th = _normalize_handles(source_handle, target_handle)

    existing_id = session.execute(
        text(
            """
            SELECT id FROM topology_group_links
            WHERE map_layer = :layer
              AND source_group_id = :src AND target_group_id = :tgt
            LIMIT 1
            """
        ),
        {"layer": map_layer, "src": source.id, "tgt": target.id},
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing_id:
        session.execute(
            text(
                """
                UPDATE topology_group_links
                SET source_handle = :sh, target_handle = :th, edge_style = :style
                WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"sh": sh, "th": th, "style": edge_style, "id": existing_id},
        )
        return SimpleNamespace(id=existing_id)

    reverse_id = session.execute(
        text(
            """
            SELECT id FROM topology_group_links
            WHERE map_layer = :layer
              AND source_group_id = :tgt AND target_group_id = :src
            LIMIT 1
            """
        ),
        {"layer": map_layer, "src": source.id, "tgt": target.id},
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if reverse_id:
        session.execute(
            text(
                """
                UPDATE topology_group_links
                SET source_group_id = :src, target_group_id = :tgt,
                    source_handle = :sh, target_handle = :th, edge_style = :style
                WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"src": source.id, "tgt": target.id, "sh": sh, "th": th, "style": edge_style, "id": reverse_id},
        )
        return SimpleNamespace(id=reverse_id)

    link_id = session.execute(

            INSERT INTO topology_group_links
                (source_group_id, target_group_id, edge_style, map_layer,
                 source_handle, target_handle, status)

def infer_gateway_links(session: Session) -> int:
    created = 0
    devices = session.execute(
        select(Device).where(Device.status != DeviceStatus.RETIRED)
    ).scalars().all()

    subnets: dict[str, Device | None] = {}
    for device in devices:
        parts = device.ip_address.split(".")
        if len(parts) != 4:
            continue
        subnet = ".".join(parts[:3])
        if device.device_type == "router" or device.ip_address.endswith(".1"):
            subnets[subnet] = device

    for device in devices:
        parts = device.ip_address.split(".")
        if len(parts) != 4:
            continue
        subnet = ".".join(parts[:3])
        gateway = subnets.get(subnet)
        if not gateway or gateway.id == device.id:
            continue

        neighbor = NeighborInfo(
            local_port="default",
            remote_name=gateway.hostname or gateway.ip_address,
            remote_port=None,
            remote_ip=gateway.ip_address,
            protocol="inferred",
        )
        if _upsert_link(session, device, neighbor, gateway):
            created += 1
    return created


def _device_passes_filter(
    device: Device,
    device_type: str | None,
    status: str | None,
    tag: str | None,
    vlan_device_ids: set[int] | None = None,
) -> bool:
    if vlan_device_ids is not None and device.id not in vlan_device_ids:

from dataclasses import dataclass

from app.engines.discovery.snmp_collector import snmp_walk


@dataclass
class NeighborInfo:
    local_port: str | None
    remote_name: str | None
    remote_port: str | None
    remote_ip: str | None
    protocol: str


def collect_lldp_neighbors(host: str, community: str | None = None) -> list[NeighborInfo]:
    neighbors: list[NeighborInfo] = []

    sys_names = snmp_walk(host, "1.0.8802.1.1.2.1.4.1.1.9", community, limit=64)
    port_ids = snmp_walk(host, "1.0.8802.1.1.2.1.4.1.1.7", community, limit=64)
    port_descs = snmp_walk(host, "1.0.8802.1.1.2.1.4.1.1.8", community, limit=64)
    local_ports = snmp_walk(host, "1.0.8802.1.1.2.1.3.7.1.3", community, limit=64)

    for index, remote_name in enumerate(sys_names):
        if not remote_name or remote_name in ("", "0"):
            continue
        neighbors.append(
            NeighborInfo(
                local_port=local_ports[index] if index < len(local_ports) else None,
                remote_name=remote_name,
                remote_port=port_descs[index] if index < len(port_descs) else port_ids[index] if index < len(port_ids) else None,
                remote_ip=None,
                protocol="lldp",
            )
        )
    return neighbors


def collect_cdp_neighbors(host: str, community: str | None = None) -> list[NeighborInfo]:
    neighbors: list[NeighborInfo] = []

    device_ids = snmp_walk(host, "1.3.6.1.4.1.9.9.23.1.2.1.1.6", community, limit=64)
    device_ports = snmp_walk(host, "1.3.6.1.4.1.9.9.23.1.2.1.1.7", community, limit=64)

        if not remote_name:

        neighbors.append(
            NeighborInfo(

                remote_port=device_ports[index] if index < len(device_ports) else None,

    device = await db.get(Device, device_id)

    db.add(

    return DeviceImportResult(imported=imported, skipped=skipped, errors=errors)

        response = await call_next(request)
        if not settings.audit_log_enabled:
            return response
        if request.method not in ("POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"):
            return response
        path = request.url.path
        if not path.startswith("/api/") or path.startswith("/api/copilot/chat") or path.startswith("/api/auth/login"):
            return response
        try:
            from app.db_sync import SyncSession
            from app.services.audit_service import log_audit

            user_id = None
            username = None
            auth = request.headers.get("authorization", "")
            if auth.startswith("Bearer "):

                    from app.config import settings as cfg
                    from app.dependencies import ALGORITHM

                    token = auth[7:]
                    payload = jwt.decode(token, cfg.secret_key, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
                    username = payload.get("sub")
                except Exception:

            with SyncSession() as session:

                    session,
                    action=f"http.{request.method.lower()}",
                    resource_type="api",
                    resource_id=path[:120],
                    username=username,
                    ip_address=request.client.host if request.client else None,
                    outcome="success" if response.status_code < 400 else "failure",
                    details={"status": response.status_code, "method": request.method},

def _availability(device: Device) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Retorna (availability_code, label PT) — online | offline | unknown."""
    raw = device.status.value if hasattr(device.status, "value") else str(device.status or "")
    raw = raw.lower()
    if raw == DeviceStatus.ACTIVE.value or raw == "active":
        return "online", "Online"
    if raw == DeviceStatus.INACTIVE.value or raw == "inactive":
        return "offline", "Offline"
    return "unknown", "Desconhecido"


def ensure_ping_monitor(session: Session, device: Device) -> Monitor:
    """Garante monitor PING habilitado — status dinâmico + alarme offline."""
    existing = session.execute(
        select(Monitor)
        .where(
            Monitor.device_id == device.id,
            Monitor.monitor_type == MonitorType.PING,
        )
        .order_by(Monitor.id.asc())
        .limit(1)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing:
        if not existing.is_enabled:
            existing.is_enabled = True
            session.add(existing)
        return existing
    monitor = Monitor(
        device_id=device.id,
        monitor_type=MonitorType.PING,
        target=device.ip_address,
        interval_seconds=60,
        is_enabled=True,
    )
    session.add(monitor)
    session.flush()
    return monitor


def ensure_snmp_monitor(session: Session, device: Device) -> Monitor:
    """Garante monitor SNMP para métricas de sensor (temp/CPU/RAM/disco)."""
    rows = list(
        session.execute(
            select(Monitor)
            .where(
                Monitor.device_id == device.id,
                Monitor.monitor_type == MonitorType.SNMP,
            )
            .order_by(Monitor.id.asc())
        ).scalars().all()
    )
    if rows:
        primary = rows[0]
        # Remove duplicatas que quebram scalar_one_or_none em listagens
        for dup in rows[1:]:
            session.delete(dup)
        if not primary.is_enabled:
            primary.is_enabled = True
            session.add(primary)
        return primary
    monitor = Monitor(
        device_id=device.id,
        monitor_type=MonitorType.SNMP,
        target=device.ip_address,
        interval_seconds=120,
        is_enabled=True,
    )
    session.add(monitor)
    session.flush()
    return monitor


def _metrics_poll_stale(device: Device, *, ttl: int = METRICS_POLL_TTL_SECONDS) -> bool:
    zion = ((device.extra_data or {}).get("zion") or {})
    raw = zion.get("metrics_polled_at")
    if not raw:
        return True
    # Coleta só de portas não conta como inventário completo — tenta de novo em breve
    effective_ttl = 20 if zion.get("metrics_quality") == "partial" else ttl
    try:
        ts = datetime.fromisoformat(str(raw).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        if ts.tzinfo is None:
            ts = ts.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return (datetime.now(UTC) - ts).total_seconds() >= effective_ttl
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return True


def probe_open_ports(ip: str, *, timeout: float = 0.28) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Scan rápido de portas comuns (sem nmap) para popular Serviços no card."""
    import socket
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

    def _check(port: int) -> int | None:
        try:
            with socket.create_connection((ip, port), timeout=timeout):
                return port
        except OSError:
            return None

    found: list[int] = []
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=16) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(_check, p) for p in COMMON_SERVICE_PORTS]
        for fut in as_completed(futures):
            port = fut.result()
            if port is not None:
                found.append(port)
    found.sort()
    return [
        {"port": p, "protocol": "tcp", "service": PORT_SERVICE_HINTS.get(p)}
        for p in found
    ]


def refresh_device_sensor_metrics(session: Session, device: Device, *, force: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:

    from app.config import settings

    snmp_monitor = ensure_snmp_monitor(session, device)
    snmp_payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    errors: list[str] = []
    collected_any = False

    snmp_info = collect_snmp_info(ip)
    if snmp_info.reachable:
        result["sources"].append("snmp")
        collected_any = True
        ups_block = {
            "status": snmp_info.ups_status,
            "battery_charge": snmp_info.ups_battery_charge,
            "load_pct": snmp_info.ups_load_pct,
            "on_battery": snmp_info.ups_on_battery,
        }
        snmp_payload = {
            "sys_descr": snmp_info.sys_descr,
            "sys_name": snmp_info.sys_name,
            "sys_location": snmp_info.sys_location,
            "sys_uptime": snmp_info.sys_uptime,
            "vendor": snmp_info.vendor,
            "model": snmp_info.model,
            "interface_count": snmp_info.interface_count,
            "cpu_load": snmp_info.cpu_load,
            "cpu_loads": snmp_info.cpu_loads,
            "memory_used_pct": snmp_info.memory_used_pct,
            "memory_total_kb": snmp_info.memory_total_kb,
            "memory_used_kb": snmp_info.memory_used_kb,
            "disk_used_pct": snmp_info.disk_used_pct,
            "disks": snmp_info.disks,
            "temperature_c": snmp_info.temperature_c,
            "temperatures": snmp_info.temperatures,
            "interfaces": snmp_info.interfaces,

        result["temperature_c"] = snmp_info.temperature_c

            "temperature_c": snmp_info.temperature_c,
            "interface_count": snmp_info.interface_count,
            "ups_battery_charge": snmp_info.ups_battery_charge,
        }
        for name, value, unit in (
            ("cpu_load", snmp_info.cpu_load, "percent"),
            ("memory_used_pct", snmp_info.memory_used_pct, "percent"),
            ("disk_used_pct", snmp_info.disk_used_pct, "percent"),

## 0.4 Backup Postgres + `.env`

Procedimento: [`scripts/backup-sentinel.ps1`](../scripts/backup-sentinel.ps1)

```powershell
# Na raiz do repo
.\scripts\backup-sentinel.ps1
```

Gera em `backups/`:

- `sentinelai-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.sql.gz` — dump Postgres
- `env-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.backup` — cópia do `.env` (fora do git)

**Restore (resumo):**

```powershell
# Parar writers se necessário; depois:

# Preferir: gunzip -c backups\....sql.gz | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U sentinel -d sentinelai
```
